svg.title: WharfSWE cost per test by Copilot CLI revision
svg.desc: Selected WharfSWE models, with one point per completed 56-trial arm. X is the revision of CLI 1.0.x; Y shows USD per costed trial. The X axis starts at revision 95. Y axis: $0.00 to $1.40. Lines join observed runs only.

g.text: WharfSWE cost per test by Copilot CLI revision
